reports.1: [Issue Pilot] Investigate support for notebook implementation beyond the README allowlist

evidence.1:
### Pilot outcome

Implement with GPT-6 Luna

### Report and desired change

This fork's Issue Pilot currently limits generated fixes to README.md through tools/issue-pilot/config.json and bounded_proposal in tools/issue-pilot/pilot.py. I would like to explore support for implementing notebook changes, which requires Python code changes and a separate validation policy. The current documentation-only worker should investigate the request and stop for human review when it cannot implement within its existing allowlist. Do not claim that a README edit adds notebook editing support.

This issue is also the first live GPT-6 Luna / GitHub Actions / private Site integration check. No automatic merge is requested.
